steps.code:
# Extract all quotes from the note content and pick a random one
import random

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
quotes = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        quote = line[2:].strip()
        quotes.append(quote)

# Pick a random quote
random_quote = random.choice(quotes)
print(random_quote)
